(1) F04 (scope_limitations): the authored 'not implemented' bullet cites all six SUPPORTED Mesh.* boolean-operation facts (union/difference/intersect/doBoolean/optimize/isManifold - confirmed present in the unit's own fact_ids in content_units.json) but its prose names only 'mesh boolean operations' generically rather than each method, and separately claims the candidate omits the binary glTF export failure - which is factually wrong: scope_limitations/limitation:3, a DIFFERENT unit in the SAME section, states it correctly ('Binary glTF export with binaryMode set to true currently fails...'). review.py's fold stack (absence_defect/factuality_defect/scope_defect, version 11) evaluates only the finding's own unit and section-slice text; it has no mechanism to recognize that a claimed-absent fact is genuinely present in a sibling unit of the same candidate, so this finding never receives a reviewer_scope_defect tag (unlike five of this draw's other findings, which did fold) and stands as a hard block. findings.detail: Measured on aspose-3d-foss/Aspose.3D-FOSS-for-TypeScript, revision 7b959706f2ad976db929f26ec079f43a07d578e1, this draw. Finding F06 (additional_examples, criterion factuality, fact_ids [example:007]) quotes the workflow-preview bullet 'Convert an STL file to GLTF text format' and claims the candidate omits the binary-glTF-export-failure caveat - but scope_limitations/limitation:3 (fact_ids [example:008, inherited_unit:077.list]), a different unit in a different section of the identical candidate, states exactly that caveat: 'Binary glTF export with binaryMode set to true currently fails, while JSON/ASCII glTF export remains functional and unaffected.' Finding F04 (scope_limitations, fact_ids naming all six SUPPORTED Mesh.* boolean-operation facts plus others) makes the same shape of claim about the same missing caveat, alongside a separate, distinct complaint (six cited-but-not-individually-named mesh methods, a content/prose completeness question left to the owner to characterize). absence_defect requires the claimed-absent string inside the candidate's OWN section slice; factuality_defect/cited_fact_defect check only the finding's own reviewed unit's fact_ids and citations (item 83/116/118's own widenings). None of the three checks a finding calls in the fold stack ever look at a sibling unit's or sibling section's own SUPPORTED, cited text to see whether the document as a whole already states the claimed-absent fact. One repair attempt per finding was correctly refused as unrepairable (item 93's changes-ledger-corroboration guard: both attempted revisions were byte-identical to their inputs, since there was nothing wrong to fix - the candidate is already factually complete, the reviewer's own claim is what is inaccurate). Proposed, smallest first, not attempted: widen the fold stack's own lookup (or add a sibling check reachable from absence_defect/factuality_defect) to also search the candidate's own already-composed content_units.json for a SUPPORTED, cited unit whose text carries the claimed-absent value, before refusing to fold - scoped to the candidate's own units only, never invented text, the same discipline item 116/118 already apply to their own widened lookups.

findings.title: identifier_tokens's _CAMEL pattern requires an identifier's first letter to be uppercase, so a bare lowerCamelCase method name named verbatim in an inherited unit's own prose - without a Class. prefix or an immediately trailing () - never becomes a token item 110's deterministic symbol top-up can match against a SUPPORTED public_symbol fact.
findings.detail: Measured on the same repository and revision, traced while diagnosing F04/LANE-B-W14R8-F1 (not itself the cause of any finding in this draw - the reviewer's own findings never name the affected FileSystem methods). inherited_unit:077.list's own text names, verbatim in backticks inside one parenthetical, five FileSystem-related members: 'the standalone `FileSystem` helpers (`createZipFileSystem`, `readFile`, `writeFile`, `createLocalFileSystem`, `createDummyFileSystem`)'. Reproduced directly against the exact committed inherited_unit:077.list fact value at this revision (python -c using composition.authoring._inherited_unit_tokens): the resulting token set contains bare 'FileSystem' (matched by _CAMEL, PascalCase) and every dotted Mesh.*/Watermark.*/Node.*/Scene.* symbol in the same sentence (matched by _DOTTED, which requires a literal '.'), but contains none of 'createZipFileSystem', 'readFile', 'writeFile', 'createLocalFileSystem', 'createDummyFileSystem' in any form - bare or otherwise. _CAMEL (composition/authoring.py) is `\b[A-Z][a-z0-9]+(?:[A-Z][a-z0-9]*)+\b`, requiring an uppercase first letter; a bare lowerCamelCase method name matches none of identifier_tokens's five patterns (_DOTTED needs a literal dot, _SNAKE needs an underscore, _CALL needs an immediately trailing '()' which this parenthetical list's members do not carry, _CAMEL needs an uppercase first letter, _COORDINATE/_MODULE_PATH need a colon or a path). Consequently this draw's inherited_unit:077.list disposition (VERIFIED_REWRITE) fact_ids include public_symbol:filesystem (bare) and public_symbol:filesystem.createzipfilesystem (the latter from the S4 model's own live sampling this draw, confirmed by cross-checking repairs.json's pre-repair fact_ids snapshot, not from the deterministic top-up), but never public_symbol:filesystem.readfile/writefile/createlocalfilesystem/createdummyfilesystem, even though all four are SUPPORTED and named verbatim in the identical sentence the other four FileSystem-related citations came from - the same shape of gap item 110's own docstring already measured for six other symbols on this exact unit, now confirmed to persist for four specific ones with a precisely identified regex cause. Proposed, smallest first, not attempted: widen _CAMEL (or add a sibling pattern) to also match a bare lowercase-initial camelCase identifier of at least two humps, scoped exactly as identifier_tokens's other four patterns already are - deterministic, no LLM call, no change to which facts are SUPPORTED.
findings.evidence: facts.json inherited_unit:077.list (SUPPORTED, full text quoted above) and the five public_symbol:filesystem* facts (all SUPPORTED); dispositions.json inherited_unit:077.list disposition (VERIFIED_REWRITE, fact_ids include filesystem and filesystem.createzipfilesystem, exclude filesystem.readfile/writefile/createlocalfilesystem/createdummyfilesystem); repairs.json attempt b0e43fe2abafc344b9b794eb's own quoted pre-repair fact_ids string (does not include the four missing filesystem facts either, at the S6/content-unit level); src/repository_presenter/components/readme/composition/authoring.py lines 47-56 (_DOTTED/_SNAKE/_CAMEL/_CALL/_COORDINATE), lines 850-859 (identifier_tokens), lines 943-954 (_inherited_unit_tokens), lines 992-1021 (inherited_unit_named_symbols); direct reproduction via python -c against the committed source at this revision (recorded in this item's own session, not re-included here to keep this record evidence-only).
